subject: Request; More messages during model runs

messages.author: 4b681bcd9d4d425d
messages.subject: Request; More messages during model runs
parts:
Hi all,

This is applicable to RStan, though it's a more general issue. In short, I'd like more information about what is happening as the model runs. (verbose=TRUE doesn't give me the information I'd like.)

RSATN feature request details;
When I run a complex model, after compiling (which it doesn't announce,) it tells me SAMPLING FOR MODEL '[name here]' NOW, 
(Here; https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/blob/2cf7e0720a44a57ee75e23ef802d9ba6063a1c0a/rstan/rstan/R/stanmodel-class.R at line 532)
then it (sometimes) waits a significant amount of time before *beginning* to sample.

I'd prefer a few more informational messages that inform me what is taking a long time. Before sampling, in non-verbose mode, it could tell me it was parsing data, (line 373) then compiling (line 388). 
(ie. "Parsing Input Data", "Compiling Stan model to executable" - I could potentially make these changes on Github myself, it this is an OK thing to add to RStan.)

Stan Feature Requests, also - perhaps less simple to address;
After compiling, it's no longer an RStan issue, it's Stan itself; I get no information for an extended period, about 5 minutes with my big models even when they run, after it says Sampling, but before it says "Iteration:  1/n". I'm very unclear about what is causing this to go slowly, and think that (at least using verbose mode) it could allow for some more transparency into what is happening with the sampler, though I'm not familiar with that code.
Also, during the model run itself, it's probably doing tons of leapfrog steps, etc - and I'd be happy to have a "super-verbose" mode that told me what was happening in a bit more detail this; I can have it tell me about each iteration, but it seems during runtime that's the limit of how much detail I can get during the run. (At least via RStan.)

Thanks,
David

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Request; More messages during model runs
parts:
We absolutely want pull requests. Usually people send them in for
bug fixes. We usually spend some time discussing features before
scheduling and coding them.

One thing you can do to get more output is use refresh=1.

I'm all for a more verbose option by the way. Would you mind
creating an issue and pull request in the form outlined here:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki#developer-process

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/Pull-Request-Template

We haven't been as strict for RStan as for Stan and the math lib,
so I'm a little unclear in terms of what testing Ben and Jiqiang
and Jonah want to see.

Thanks.

- Bob
